arms.name: random_scaled_anchor10_ema
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

execution.sparse_steps: dense forward with gathered 87.5% FFN backward and 8/7 gradient scaling
execution.anchor_steps: every tenth step uses native dense forward and native dense backward with no oracle gates, sparse scaling, or gather/scatter
execution.ema: identical final 0.95 EMA for every arm with no decay sweep or intermediate checkpoint selection
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference with averaged weights

cost_accounting.realized_row_formula: same CPU-calibrated formula on sparse steps and full dense cost on anchor steps
cost_accounting.auxiliary_operations: sparse scoring, gather/scatter and gradient scaling only on non-anchor steps; two EMA operations per parameter per step on every step
cost_accounting.evaluation: reported separately and excluded from training-plus-EMA cost

primary_endpoint: final EMA ordinary dense held-out loss at training-plus-anchor-plus-scaling-plus-EMA cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: anchored low_max_abs does not beat anchored random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: anchored low_max_abs beats random but not dense EMA; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: anchored low_max_abs EMA loss is below random and dense EMA while total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: changing anchor frequency, scale, activity, EMA decay, steps, or evaluation after launch
using the failed sparse-forward anchor mechanism
omitting dense anchor cost or EMA overhead
launching body 7 without a development-level win
